This is the best dental office I've ever been to in the world, I swear.
I came in two weeks ago to have a decayed wisdom tooth removed, and I was really nervous (extremely). The dentist was extremely professional and put me at ease; the extraction wasn't easy, but she handled it with confidence.
Her attitude alone was reassuring. It's 2weeks after & I don't have any problems with that tooth anymore!

I went back yesterday to check that everything was okay, to have some retainer wires placed, and to get a teeth cleaning.
This time I saw a man who was just as professional, and passionate—he explained every step of the procedure! Everything went perfectly. Normally, my teeth are sensitive after a cleaning, but not this time.
I think there’s a third dentist, if I’m not mistaken, who seems very professional too!! The whole reception team is just so sweet.
Honestly, I’ve had a lot of bad expériences, but I’ll never go anywhere else but here—I’m really happy.
Thank you for everything Stay kind and keep smiling ☺️ kamphunakha 🙏🏼

text: At first check for my broken teeth it felt everything good, doctor insisted to make a tooth extraction next day and I agreed. But next day sadly it turned into a nightmare. The first problem is the anesthetic injection was not used properly and there were almost no numbness. Then a second one was applied, again it did not work. And I have never before seen that only after a minute or two waiting time when the anesthesia was injected, that the doctor immediately wants to take action. At least there need to be a proper waiting time until the patient and doctor is sure that the material started to work. However again the same, immediate tapping on the tooth and suggesting a third one. I know very well how it goes with many anesthesia injections and it makes it more vulnerable later to recover and increases the risk of complex recovery. At first I did not want a third one but later agreed because I wanted to get rid finally from this pain during my vacation. So they injected the third one, again without proper waiting, the doctor suggested nitrous oxide, many know it as laughing gas and used generally to calm down children, not very effective for sedation actually if the injection doesn't work. Well maybe I thought okey, still it can help, but then understood that's applied in a totally different clinic which was slowly breaking my trust. They took me there, started to give me the gas, at one point I was really feeling bad, couldn't get proper breath, told them to stop, no he insisted to go further, I was about to collapse totally, begged to stop, no he was going further, I couldn't stop myself and stood up and ended. Until this point my stomach and body was at the end, so many painkillers were given (despite I have warned that it can have side risks), just to push things faster. When we arrived at the clinic back, the doctor immediately disappeared, no talk, no suggestion, just the guy at the reception was helping out (thank you for him especially). However, at that time (half an hour later, finally the numbness was felt), at that point I asked to immediately start the procedure before the numbness goes away... No again, minutes after minutes waiting, again blood pressure measure, again waiting until the doctor takes me in and the pain was again there. The inside where the pain was coming was not injected one time, only very soft ones at the other end, how this should stop the pain on the nerves on the spot? After I told the pain was there, the doctor this time suggested me that I should go Bangkok hospital next day, again another hospital suggestion instead to solve it with own expertise. I said ok, after two hours of suffering, they told me it's over I can go. There was loads of rain today in Phuket and it was already very late and traffic full. Nobody picked me up for 1,5 hours because of that chaos, clinic has closed in the meantime, everyone had gone, and I tried to find back with a much worse pain at the beginning my way home. Now I can't even use my mouth at all, everything in pain and left alone from a clinic I have trusted. But I shouldn't do that with any service in Phuket, it's my failure actually. However the conclusion is, my pain got worse, got sick from waiting under rain for 1,5 hours, problem not solved, vacation destroyed, being referred to another clinic which I have called and they told it can take time until I could get the proper treatment. That means, if you really want to come to this clinic for treating a serious issue, sadly the expertise isn't there when it's needed. Either it gets worse or you're referred at the end to somewhere else.
